title: Track a dispatched order
excerpt: Open Order History and select Track shipment. Standard delivery normally takes 3–5 business days after dispatch and express delivery takes 1–2 business days. Tracking can take 24 hours to show its first scan. Escalate if the delivery window has passed or tracking has not changed for three business days.
keywords: tracking|shipment|carrier|dispatch|delivery status

title: Late delivery
excerpt: Confirm the dispatch date shipping service destination and latest carrier scan. Allow the published delivery window for ordinary delays. If the parcel is beyond that window or tracking has been inactive for three business days route it to Shipping Review with the order ID and tracking reference.
keywords: late delivery|delayed parcel|shipping delay|carrier scan|order tracking

title: Delivered but missing
excerpt: Ask the customer to check the address safe places reception household members and nearby neighbours. If the parcel remains missing 24 hours after the delivery scan collect the order ID and confirm the address through the secure workflow. Escalate for a carrier investigation and do not promise an immediate refund.
keywords: delivered not received|missing parcel|safe place|carrier investigation|proof of delivery

title: Cancel an order
excerpt: Orders can be cancelled only before warehouse packing begins. Use Order History and select Cancel order when available. If the option is absent collect the order ID and route to Order Support. Do not promise cancellation after dispatch; eligible products can use the return process after delivery.
keywords: cancel order|stop shipment|warehouse packing|order history|before dispatch

title: Change delivery address
excerpt: A delivery address can be changed only before warehouse packing begins. Collect the order ID and corrected address through the approved secure workflow. If packing or dispatch has started explain that the address cannot be edited and route urgent cases to Order Support to check carrier options.
keywords: change address|wrong address|delivery address|shipping address|before packing

title: Standard return policy
excerpt: Most unused products in original condition may be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery. Final-sale products personalized goods and opened hygiene products are normally excluded. Start the return from Order History. Ask for the order ID and item when eligibility is unclear and do not promise approval before checking exclusions.
keywords: return policy|30 days|return item|final sale|return eligibility

title: Exchange size or colour
excerpt: Eligible unused apparel and footwear may be exchanged within the 30-day return period while replacement stock is available. Start from Order History and choose Exchange. If the desired option is unavailable use a return and place a new order. Final-sale and personalized items are normally excluded.
keywords: exchange|wrong size|change colour|replacement stock|apparel return

title: Refund processing time
excerpt: After a return is received and approved the refund is sent to the original payment method. Banks normally display it within 5–10 business days. Ask for the order ID and confirmation date. If ten business days have passed route the case to Billing Review. Never ask for a full card number.
keywords: refund status|refund pending|5-10 business days|original payment|money back

title: Damaged product
excerpt: Collect the order ID affected item packaging condition and clear damage photos. Ask the customer to keep the product and packaging until review. Route leaking batteries smoke overheating or injury concerns to urgent human review. Ordinary damage goes to Order Support for a policy decision on replacement or refund.
keywords: damaged item|broken product|photos|replacement|unsafe product

title: Wrong or missing item
excerpt: Collect the order ID the item received the expected item and photos of the product and packing slip when available. For a missing item confirm whether the shipment was split. Route the evidence to Order Support and do not promise an outcome before review.
keywords: wrong item|missing item|packing slip|fulfilment error|split shipment

title: Duplicate charge
excerpt: Distinguish a temporary authorization from two completed charges. Ask for the order ID transaction dates amounts and only approved payment identifiers. Never request a full card number. Completed duplicates chargebacks fraud claims or angry financial disputes require Billing Review and must not be auto-resolved.
keywords: charged twice|duplicate charge|double payment|authorization|billing dispute

title: Card declined
excerpt: Ask the customer to verify billing address card expiry available funds and bank approval or try another payment method. Northstar Market cannot see the bank's private decline reason. Never request the full card number or security code. Repeated failures or suspected fraud require Billing Review.
keywords: card declined|payment failed|bank blocked|checkout payment|try another card

title: Download an invoice
excerpt: Open Order History select the order and choose Download invoice after payment is captured. An invoice is also sent to the purchase email. If missing ask for the order ID or purchase email and route business tax-detail changes to Billing Review.
keywords: invoice|receipt|tax invoice|download bill|order history

title: Update saved payment method
excerpt: Add or remove a saved payment method under Account Settings and Payments. A payment method for an existing order normally cannot be changed. Never collect full card data in chat. For subscriptions update the default method before renewal and escalate unauthorized changes.
keywords: update card|payment method|saved card|billing settings|renewal card

title: Gift cards
excerpt: Enter a gift card at checkout. Gift cards do not expire and are not normally redeemable for cash except where law requires. Never request the complete gift-card code in ordinary chat. Lost stolen blocked or unexpectedly empty cards require Billing Review and proof of purchase.
keywords: gift card|voucher|gift balance|redeem code|lost gift card

title: Promotional codes
excerpt: Enter one valid promotional code at checkout before payment. Codes normally cannot be combined or applied after an order is placed. Check expiry exclusions minimum spend and account eligibility. If the displayed terms were met but the code fails collect a screenshot and route for review.
keywords: promo code|coupon|discount code|voucher failed|minimum spend

title: Cancel a subscription
excerpt: Open Account Settings and Subscriptions then choose Cancel before the next renewal. Cancellation stops future renewals but does not automatically refund a completed charge. If the control is missing or a charge completed collect the subscription reference and route to Billing Review.
keywords: cancel subscription|stop renewal|membership|recurring charge|billing cycle

title: Backorders and preorders
excerpt: Backordered products ship when replenished and preorders ship near the estimated release date. Estimates can change and are not guarantees. Review the latest date in Order History. If cancellation is available the customer may cancel before packing; route materially missed estimates or unavailable cancellation to Order Support.
keywords: backorder|preorder|release date|out of stock|estimated ship date

title: International duties and taxes
excerpt: International orders may incur import duties taxes or carrier fees imposed by local authorities. These are separate unless checkout explicitly says otherwise. Support cannot waive government charges. Route amounts charged by Northstar Market to Billing Review and refer government assessments to local customs.
keywords: customs duty|import tax|international order|carrier fee|border charge

title: Marketplace seller orders
excerpt: Marketplace products identify the seller on the product and order pages. Contact the seller through the secure order thread. Northstar Market can intervene when the seller misses the response window tracking is invalid or policy is violated. Escalate suspected counterfeit unsafe or fraudulent listings.
keywords: marketplace seller|third party seller|seller response|counterfeit|marketplace order

title: Password reset
excerpt: Use Forgot password and follow the time-limited link sent to the account email. Check spam and request a new link if it expired. Never share passwords or one-time codes. Unexpected reset messages or changes the customer did not request require Security Ops review.
keywords: password reset|forgot password|expired reset link|cannot sign in|login help

title: Two-factor authentication
excerpt: Enable two-factor authentication in Account Settings and Security with an authenticator app. Keep recovery codes secure. If codes fail check device time or use a recovery code. Support must never ask for a current code. Lost-device cases need verification and suspicious activity requires Security Ops.
keywords: 2fa|mfa|authenticator|one time code|recovery code

title: Locked account recovery
excerpt: Repeated failed sign-ins can temporarily lock an account. Wait for the displayed period and use account recovery. If access remains blocked collect the account identifier through the secure workflow and route to Account Recovery. Unknown activity or changed details make it a security incident.
keywords: locked account|account recovery|too many attempts|identity verification|cannot access

title: Suspected account takeover
excerpt: Unknown logins changed account details unrecognized orders or unrequested reset messages are critical security concerns. Advise the customer to reset the password from a trusted device if safe and secure their email. Immediately route to Security Ops. Never auto-resolve or request passwords or one-time codes.
keywords: account hacked|unknown login|unauthorized order|account takeover|security incident

title: Privacy and account deletion
excerpt: Privacy access correction export and deletion requests must use the verified Privacy Request workflow in Account Settings. Legal retention can apply to transaction records. Do not request government ID in ordinary chat. Route verification problems legal deadlines or another person's data to the Privacy Team.
keywords: delete account|privacy request|data export|personal data|right to access
